instructions: One Grok programming bot: a single Python agent (omes/) merging the Hermes loop with the oh-my-pi harness. Tools register in families and must match contracts/tool-rosters/omes.yaml exactly; tests are hermetic (fakes/scripted peers, no network); secrets resolve via the credential broker and never appear in code, tests, or docs.

rules.rule: New or renamed tools must be registered in their family module, appended to omes/contracts/tool-rosters/omes.yaml in tuple order, and allowed in omes/contracts/policies/omes.json. Flag any of the three drifting.
Tests must not touch the network: fakes and scripted peers only. Flag live HTTP, sockets, or remote URLs in tests.
Flag hardcoded secrets, tokens, keys, passwords, or credential-shaped literals in code, tests, docs, or workflows.
Completion claims in docs, summaries, and PR text must cite the command and its exit code. Flag unproven claims.
Every docs/*.md page must be listed exactly once in docs/SUMMARY.md and start with a top-level heading. Generated pages (tool catalog) must not be hand-edited.
